metadata.title: Traditional Medicine & Natural Products in Musanze
metadata.description: Imbaraga z'Igisura offers traditional medicine and natural products in Musanze, Rwanda, near Musanze Bus Station. More than {years} years of experience. Call or WhatsApp us.

common.whatsappMessage: Hello {name}, I would like some information about your products.

hero.title: Traditional knowledge. Natural products. Trusted for over {years} years.
hero.description: Explore our traditional medicine and natural products, and contact us directly by WhatsApp or phone. We are happy to help you find what you are looking for.

products.title: Explore our products
products.description: Discover our selection of traditional medicine and natural products.
products.emptyTitle: Our products will be available here soon
products.emptyDescription: Product information, sizes and prices will be added here. In the meantime, contact us and we will gladly tell you what is available.

why.title: Why choose Imbaraga z'Igisura
why.experienceText: We have been providing traditional medicine and natural products for more than {years} years.
why.naturalText: A selection of traditional medicine and natural products, with clear information about each one.
why.personalText: You speak with us directly. We take the time to answer your questions about our products.
why.visitText: Come to our shop and speak with us in person.

order.title: How to get our products
order.step1Text: Look through our products here, or ask us what is available.
order.step2Text: Send us a WhatsApp message or call us. We will answer your questions and confirm your order.
order.step3Text: Collect your order at our shop in Musanze, or ask us whether it can be sent to you.
order.deliveryText: Depending on your location and the size of your order, products may be sent with buses travelling from Musanze to Kigali or other destinations. You collect the package yourself when it arrives.
order.deliveryNote: Please contact us first to check what is possible for your location. Sending options, timing and any costs are agreed directly with you.

info.title: Know what you are buying
info.description: Each product page will share the information available for that product, so you can choose with confidence.
info.name: Product name
info.note: Information about traditional uses comes from traditional knowledge and our experience. It is not a medical diagnosis or a promise of results. If you are pregnant, taking other medicine or have a health condition, please ask a health professional for advice.

about.title: A family business in Musanze
about.text1: Imbaraga z'Igisura provides traditional medicine and natural products in Musanze, Rwanda.
about.text2: For more than {years} years, we have been committed to helping every customer understand the products we offer: what they are, how they are traditionally used and how to use them.

contact.title: Have a question?
contact.description: Contact us directly and we'll help you find the information you need.

location.title: Location and opening hours
location.directionsNote: The map shows Musanze Bus Station. Our shop is nearby.

final.title: Ready to learn more?
final.description: Explore our products or contact {name} directly.
